description: Stage 1 Free scanner for recent Snapshot DAO governance proposals (Arbitrum, Aave, ENS). Extracts on-chain target addresses and calldata execution payloads to detect governance takeover attempts and discrepancies.

limit.description: Maximum number of proposals to fetch (default: 3)

use_curated_offline.description: If true, returns verified realistic offline curated proposals without outbound network calls
